description: Post a comment on a GitHub pull request via the workspace GitHub connection. Use it to report checklist or interview results where engineers already look: a short verdict, then per-check outcomes with evidence highlights. Needs the Stunt Double GitHub App installed on the repository; call get_pull_request first to confirm the PR is reachable.

body.description: Comment body in GitHub-flavoured Markdown. Lead with a one-line verdict, then per-check outcomes, and link the run report rather than pasting full transcripts.

owner.description: GitHub repository owner (user or organisation), e.g. "vercel".

pr_number.description: Pull request number, e.g. 42 for owner/repo#42.

repo.description: GitHub repository name without the owner, e.g. "next.js".

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: comment_on_pr

comment_id.description: GitHub id of the comment that was posted.

comment_url.description: Link to the comment on github.com.

title: Comment on pull request
